title: Illustrative buy-versus-build choices depend on strategic fit and operating ownership.
subtitle: Use the following questions to compare options; cost and feasibility assumptions require local validation.
decision_summary: Select a path after comparing business differentiation, data control, fit, delivery capacity, and lifecycle ownership.
buy_fit: Capability is common across the market; Configuration meets priority workflows.
buy_tradeoff: Confirm integration and data portability. Review vendor controls, roadmap, and ongoing fees.
build_fit: The workflow supports distinct value. Teams can own the product over time.
build_tradeoff: Validate skills, support, and lifecycle cost. Plan for security, upgrades, and technical debt.
economics_heading: Compare effort across the full modernization lifecycle
planning_stage_1_detail: Baseline discovery effort and decision uncertainty.
planning_stage_2_detail: Estimate build, testing, migration, and transition needs.
planning_stage_3_detail: Assess support, change, and maintenance ownership.
